purpose: Deterministic diagnostic decomposition of the immutable Q089 performance result before any new risk, diversification or signal hypothesis is tested.

definitions.drawdown_interval: Largest compounded base-cost net drawdown interval of each Q089 arm.
definitions.active_set_overlap: Daily Jaccard similarity of symbols with non-zero target weight.
definitions.adverse_overlap: Same Jaccard metric restricted to days when either member arm is underwater.
definitions.return_correlation: Pearson correlation of reconstructed base-cost net daily returns across all evaluated days and days when either member arm is underwater.
definitions.regime: Equal-weight mean of fixed universe open-to-open returns; trend uses prior 63 evaluated days and volatility uses prior 21 evaluated days versus the preceding 252 available volatility observations, excluding the evaluated day.
definitions.turnover_cost: Base Q089 transaction-cost rate 0.0015 multiplied by reconstructed absolute daily weight change.
definitions.symbol_attribution: Descriptive weighted-return less proportional turnover-cost contribution over full, research, holdout and exact worst-drawdown intervals.
